purpose: Make the user's existing Agent reliably capable of using Kungfu before asking the user to adopt a new work interface.

firstEntry.principle: Kungfu's first entry is an Agent capability, not a new daily work interface.
firstEntry.primaryRoute: Give the user's existing Agent an exact local kungfu agent brief command and ask it to guide the first Project and Work.
firstEntry.prompt: Run `<exact local CLI> agent brief`, then guide me through my first Project and Work. Keep me in my current agent, and use Kungfu as the durable Work layer.
firstEntry.cliAvailability: The prompt carries an exact local command even when kungfu is not yet on the Agent's PATH; GUI also offers an explicit PATH install action.
firstEntry.surfaceRole: GUI and TUI are optional control and observation surfaces; kungfu run codex|claude|opencode|amp preserves the user's familiar Agent.
firstEntry.completionRule: A versioned user-level state is shared by GUI and TUI; completion or explicit dismissal returns later launches to normal Work while Getting Started remains reopenable.

definitions.Project: one local directory whose work and retained Kungfu evidence are managed together
definitions.Work: one bounded outcome to create, run, review, and complete inside a Project
definitions.Agent: the provider process selected to perform or independently review Work

machineScopes.Projects: the persistent machine-local library of opened or initialized Project directories
machineScopes.All Work: the active, completed, or complete machine-local Work projection across every available Project

goldenPath: Teach the existing Agent with kungfu agent brief

agentExecution.workOwns: no WorkConsole or SessionAttempt lifecycle; Work remains authoritative without any Agent Session
agentExecution.agentSessionObserves: an Agent-owned WorkConsole may hold one replaceable current Work observation, but it cannot admit, claim, advance, review, complete, or seal Work
agentExecution.completionRule: Agent output, readiness, or exit never completes Work; human review and native Work evidence remain required
agentExecution.recoveryRule: A lost process creates an unrecoverable attempt and an explicit new-attempt action without creating a second Work item
agentExecution.nativeInteractiveRule: A bare kungfu run <agent> preserves the provider-native terminal while registering an Agent-owned observer-only SessionAttempt; any current Work observation is optional and replaceable
agentExecution.nativeObserverRule: TUI shows explicit fresh, stale, disconnected, degraded, or unknown Core Work observation and never reads terminal bytes or controls provider input

progressiveDisclosure.rule: Internal authority nouns may appear in evidence, diagnostics, APIs, and explain views, but not as first-layer navigation, calls to action, or prerequisites.

historyProtection.userRule: Agent session activity is not protected Work history until an owning domain accepts it with a verifiable receipt.

framework/tui/src/agent-work-lab-view.ts: Keep your agent. Give it durable Work.
framework/tui/src/starter-project-view/i: Available Agents with their exact source
